events.title: N.E.O.N. HORIZON (Steam Next Fest)
events.summary: Hi everyone!N.E.O.N. events.title: N.E.O.N. HORIZON (DevLog #3 — Evolution)
events.summary: Hello everyone.Today I’d like to share some news about how the project has been evolving.Over the past few weeks, I’ve been working on the idea of creating your own ship, which has now been implemented and is available in the DEMO with the latest update.Originally, the project only had pre-made ship models and builds. They were different from each other, and each had its own unique and expensive upgrade path that could eventually make it almost overpowered.Those ships are still in the game today

events.title: Major DEMO update (again) :)
events.summary: Hi, everyone Today, I’m excited to share one of our biggest updates yet.The highlight of this update is the full-fledged Ship Builder.You can now design your own ship from the hull up, combine different parts and modules, and create unique configurations built around your playstyle. events.title: N.E.O.N. HORIZON (DevLog #1 - Ships and Shipyard)
events.summary: Hi all.Today I'll talk about ships, the shipyard, and the leveling system in the game.There are currently three finished ships available in the DEMO: - Assault — a balanced ship in terms of both damage and mobility. A classic choice. - Tank — slow, but with high starting damage and strong shields. - Engineer — fast, but weak at the beginning. events.title: Big update.
events.summary: Hello everyone. Today, the project has received many changes and additions (thank you very much for your feedback and comments). - Completely redesigned interface.- Completely redesigned enemy designs.- Completely redesigned player ships.- Added visual enhancements to player ships based on installed modules.- Added random events (both obvious and subtle).- Reworked enemy and boss balance.- Completely removed AI elements. We read every comment and try to take them into account.Thank you very much
